tldr: Mars in Aquarius: action is principled, independent, and system-disrupting.
body: With Mars in Aquarius, drive moves through ideas, networks, and the urge to break stale patterns. You act when the future needs a different structure.
gift: Innovation, social courage, independence, and strategic rebellion.
challenge: Detachment, stubborn contrarianism, and fighting the system while ignoring the person in front of you.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
